User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account on TheDigiOcean platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and communication.

name.description: The full name of the user.

plan.description: The user's current subscription plan (e.g., Free, Trial, Pro, Algo/Quant).

trialEndsAt.description: The timestamp when the user's trial period ends, if applicable.

razorpayCustomerId.description: The customer ID from Razorpay for billing purposes.

credits.description: The number of AI credits available to the user.

experienceLevel.description: The user's self-declared trading experience level (e.g., Beginner, Experienced).

riskProfile.description: The user's self-declared risk tolerance profile (e.g., Conservative, Moderate, Aggressive).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

lastLogin.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Stores personalized settings for a user, including AI model preferences and UI configurations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserSettings entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User associated with these settings. (Relationship: User 1:1 UserSettings)

primaryAiModel.description: The primary AI model selected by the user for general analysis (e.g., Gemini 1.5 Pro).

geminiApiKeyEncrypted.description: Encrypted API key for Google Gemini, if the user provides their own.

openaiApiKeyEncrypted.description: Encrypted API key for OpenAI (ChatGPT), if the user provides their own.

claudeApiKeyEncrypted.description: Encrypted API key for Anthropic Claude, if the user provides their own.

languagePreference.description: The preferred language for AI responses (e.g., English, Hinglish, Hindi).

analysisDepth.description: Default depth for AI analysis (e.g., Quick, Detailed, Deep).

defaultChartTheme.description: The user's preferred chart theme (e.g., Dark, Light, Auto).

defaultTerminalLayout.description: The default layout for the multi-chart terminal (e.g., Single, 4-Grid).

compactMode.description: Indicates if compact UI mode is enabled.

showMascot.description: Indicates if the Digi mascot should be shown.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user settings were first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user settings were last updated.

RiskLimits.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits.description: Defines the risk management limits and preferences set by a user for the AI Risk Guardian.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RiskLimits entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User associated with these risk limits. (Relationship: User 1:1 RiskLimits)

dailyLossLimitInr.description: Maximum INR amount a user is willing to lose in a single day.

dailyLossLimitPct.description: Maximum percentage of capital a user is willing to lose in a single day.

perTradeMaxLoss.description: Maximum INR loss allowed for a single trade.

maxTradesPerDay.description: Maximum number of trades allowed in a single day.

maxConsecutiveLosses.description: Number of consecutive losses before a risk intervention (e.g., lock).

consecutiveLossLock.description: Indicates if auto-lock should be triggered after max consecutive losses.

maxLotSizeFno.description: Maximum F&O lot size allowed per trade.

dailyProfitLock.description: Optional daily profit target at which trading may be locked or restricted to protect gains.

coolingPeriodMins.description: Cooling-off period in minutes after a loss before placing a new trade.

revengeSensitivity.description: Sensitivity level for revenge trade detection (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Paranoid).

fomoBlockEnabled.description: Enables blocking of trades identified as FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out).

greedProtectionEnabled.description: Enables AI detection and intervention for greed-driven trading patterns.

autoAlgoPause.description: Indicates if active algorithms should be automatically paused when limits are hit.

autoCancelPending.description: Indicates if pending orders should be automatically cancelled when limits are hit.

accountabilityPartnerName.description: Name of the user's accountability partner, if configured.

accountabilityPartnerContact.description: Contact information (mobile/email) for the accountability partner.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when these risk limits were last updated.

RiskIncident.title: RiskIncident
RiskIncident.description: Logs detected risk-related incidents (revenge, greed) by the AI Risk Guardian.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RiskIncident entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User experiencing the incident. (Relationship: User 1:N RiskIncident)

incidentType.description: The type of risk incident detected (e.g., Revenge Trade, Greed, Daily Loss Limit).

severityLevel.description: The severity level of the incident (e.g., Gentle Nudge, Firm Warning, Strong Intervention, Auto-Lock).

triggerData.description: JSON string containing raw data or signals that triggered the incident, for analysis.

actionTaken.description: The action taken by the AI Risk Guardian in response to the incident.

pnlAtIncident.description: The user's P&L at the time the incident occurred.

tradesAtIncident.description: Number of trades executed by the user at the time of the incident.

overrideUsed.description: Indicates if the user chose to override the AI's intervention.

overrideReason.description: The reason provided by the user for overriding the intervention, if applicable.

preventedLossEstimate.description: An estimated amount of loss prevented by the AI's intervention.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the risk incident was recorded.

RiskLock.title: RiskLock
RiskLock.description: Records instances where trading was locked by the AI Risk Guardian.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RiskLock entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User whose trading was locked. (Relationship: User 1:N RiskLock)

lockReason.description: The primary reason for the trading lock (e.g., Daily Loss Limit Reached, Critical Revenge Pattern).

lockType.description: The type of lock applied (e.g., Auto, Manual).

unlockRequestedAt.description: Timestamp when an unlock was requested, if applicable.

unlockedAt.description: Timestamp when trading was unlocked, if applicable.

overrideEmailSent.description: Indicates if an override email with OTP was sent.

overrideEmailConfirmed.description: Indicates if the override email OTP was successfully confirmed.

pnlAtLock.description: The user's P&L at the time of the lock.

tradesAtLock.description: Number of trades executed by the user at the time of the lock.

BrokerConnection.title: BrokerConnection
BrokerConnection.description: Stores encrypted details and status of a user's connection to a trading broker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BrokerConnection entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this broker connection. (Relationship: User 1:N BrokerConnection)

brokerName.description: The name of the connected broker (e.g., Zerodha, Upstox).

apiKeyEncrypted.description: Encrypted API key for the broker's API.

apiSecretEncrypted.description: Encrypted API secret for the broker's API.

totpSecretEncrypted.description: Encrypted TOTP secret for automatic session renewal, if applicable.

accessTokenEncrypted.description: Encrypted access token for the broker's API session.

accountId.description: The user's account ID at the connected broker.

clientName.description: The client name associated with the broker account.

availableMargin.description: The current available margin for trading in the broker account.

fnoMargin.description: The current available F&O margin in the broker account.

status.description: The connection status to the broker (e.g., Connected, Disconnected, Error).

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this is the user's primary broker for order execution.

permissions.description: JSON string detailing the permissions granted for this broker connection (e.g., read positions, place orders).

connectedAt.description: Timestamp when the broker connection was first established.

lastRefreshed.description: Timestamp when the broker token/session was last refreshed.

Watchlist.title: Watchlist
Watchlist.description: Represents a user-defined watchlist of financial symbols.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Watchlist entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this watchlist. (Relationship: User 1:N Watchlist)

name.description: The name of the watchlist (e.g., 'My Favourites', 'Intraday Picks').

symbols.description: An array of symbols (e.g., 'NIFTY50', 'RELIANCE.NSE') in the watchlist.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the watchlist was created.

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description: Records details of a single trade executed by the user, including P&L and behavioral tags.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Trade entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who executed this trade. (Relationship: User 1:N Trade)

symbol.description: The trading symbol of the instrument (e.g., 'NIFTY50', 'RELIANCE.NSE').

exchange.description: The exchange where the trade was executed (e.g., 'NSE', 'BSE').

segment.description: The market segment of the trade (e.g., 'EQUITY', 'FUTURES', 'OPTIONS').

qty.description: The quantity or number of lots traded.

entryPrice.description: The average entry price of the trade.

exitPrice.description: The average exit price of the trade. Null if the position is still open.

pnl.description: The absolute Profit and Loss for the trade.

pnlPct.description: The percentage Profit and Loss for the trade.

status.description: The current status of the trade (e.g., 'OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'PENDING', 'CANCELLED', 'PARTIAL_CLOSED').

strategyId.description: Reference to the Strategy that this trade belongs to, if any. (Relationship: Strategy 1:N Trade)

algoId.description: Reference to the Algo that executed this trade, if any. (Relationship: Algo 1:N Trade)

brokerOrderId.description: The unique order ID provided by the broker for this trade.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when the trade position was opened.

closedAt.description: Timestamp when the trade position was closed. Null if the position is still open.

preTradePlan.description: User's notes on the plan or reasoning before taking the trade.

postTradeReview.description: User's notes on what happened and lessons learned after the trade.

emotionTag.description: User-tagged emotion or AI-detected emotion for the trade (e.g., 'Disciplined', 'FOMO', 'Revenge').

setupQuality.description: User-rated quality of the trade setup, typically on a scale (e.g., 1-5 stars).

followedRules.description: Indicates if the user followed their trading rules (e.g., 'Yes', 'Partially', 'No').

revengeTradeFlag.description: Flag indicating if this trade was identified as a revenge trade by AI or user.

revengeTradeScore.description: A score indicating the probability or intensity of revenge trading for this trade.

geminiReview.description: Gemini AI's automated review and analysis of the trade based on historical data.

tags.description: An array of custom tags associated with the trade.

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: Represents a trading signal generated by the AI for a specific instrument.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Signal entity.

symbol.description: The trading symbol to which the signal applies.

exchange.description: The exchange where the instrument is traded.

segment.description: The market segment of the instrument (e.g., EQUITY, FUTURES, OPTIONS).

direction.description: The suggested trade direction (e.g., BUY, SELL, NEUTRAL).

entryLow.description: The lower bound of the recommended entry price range.

entryHigh.description: The upper bound of the recommended entry price range.

target1.description: The first target price for the trade.

target2.description: The second target price for the trade.

target3.description: The third target price for the trade.

stoploss.description: The recommended stop loss price for the trade.

rrRatio.description: The Risk-Reward ratio of the suggested trade.

confidence.description: The confidence level (in percentage) of the AI in this signal.

signalType.description: The type of signal generated (e.g., Breakout, VWAP, Reversal, F&O Setup).

timeframe.description: The timeframe for which the signal is valid (e.g., Intraday, Swing, Positional).

basisTags.description: An array of strings indicating the analytical basis for the signal (e.g., 'Technical', 'FII Buying', 'Option Chain').

geminiNarrative.description: A brief narrative explanation of the signal from Gemini AI.

fiiConfirmation.description: Indicates if the signal is confirmed by FII data.

vixAtSignal.description: The India VIX value at the time the signal was generated.

firedAt.description: Timestamp when the signal was generated/fired.

validUntil.description: Timestamp until which the signal is considered valid.

status.description: The current status of the signal (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'EXECUTED').

outcome.description: The outcome of the signal if acted upon (e.g., 'PROFIT', 'LOSS', 'BREAKEVEEN').

aiModelUsed.description: The specific AI model used to generate this signal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Algo entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who created this algorithm. (Relationship: User 1:N Algo)

name.description: The name of the trading algorithm.

description.description: A description of what the algorithm does.

code.description: The Python code or script defining the algorithm logic.

visualConfig.description: JSON string representing the configuration from the visual algo builder.

riskConfig.description: JSON string containing algorithm-specific risk parameters and rules.

status.description: The deployment status of the algorithm (e.g., 'Deployed', 'Paused', 'Draft', 'Error').

mode.description: The execution mode of the algorithm (e.g., 'Live', 'Paper').

brokerId.description: Reference to the BrokerConnection used by this algorithm. (Relationship: BrokerConnection 1:N Algo)

capitalAllocated.description: The capital allocated for this specific algorithm.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the algorithm was last updated.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated the backtest. (Relationship: User 1:N BacktestRun)

endDate.description: The end date of the backtesting period.

universe.description: The market universe or symbols included in the backtest.

SignalsPerformance.title: SignalsPerformance

Portfolio.title: Portfolio

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this portfolio. (Relationship: User 1:N Portfolio)

BillingInvoice.description: Records details of billing invoices for user subscriptions or credit purchases.

userId.description: Reference to the User to whom the invoice belongs. (Relationship: User 1:N BillingInvoice)

definition.description: Top-level collection for user profiles. The document ID `{userId}` matches the user's authentication UID. Includes user plan, credits, and profile details.
Subcollection for user-specific settings. The document ID `{userSettingsId}` typically matches the `userId` or a default identifier. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

Subcollection storing a user's risk management limits and preferences. The document ID `{riskLimitsId}` typically matches the `userId` or a default identifier. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection logging detected risk-related incidents for a user. Each incident document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection recording instances where a user's trading was locked by the AI Risk Guardian. Each lock document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection storing encrypted details and status of a user's connections to trading brokers. Each connection document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection for user-defined watchlists of financial symbols. Each watchlist document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection recording details of individual trades executed by the user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence. Supports querying for open positions via `status: 'OPEN'`.
Top-level collection for AI-generated trading signals. This data is public/platform-wide and accessible based on subscription plan, not user ownership. No 'userId' needed as it's not user-owned.
Subcollection defining a user's automated trading strategies (algorithms). Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence. Supports querying for active algos via `status: 'Deployed'`.
Subcollection storing results and configurations of backtesting runs for user's algorithms. Each run document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

Top-level collection for aggregated daily FII/DII activity data. This data is public/platform-wide. Document ID `{fiiDiiDataId}` typically represents the date (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD'). No 'userId' needed as it's not user-owned.

Top-level collection tracking the performance metrics of AI-generated signals over time. This data is public/platform-wide. Document ID `{signalsPerformanceId}` typically represents the date or AI model. No 'userId' needed as it's not user-owned.

Subcollection representing a user's overall portfolio holdings. The document ID `{portfolioId}` typically matches the `userId` or a default identifier. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection logging conversational interactions with the Digi AI Trading Agent for a user. Each session document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.
Subcollection recording details of billing invoices for a user. Each invoice document includes the denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure prioritizes Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation to ensure robust security and debuggability. All user-specific data is housed within a dedicated subcollection under `/users/{userId}/`, where `{userId}` is a path parameter matching `request.auth.uid`. Each document in these subcollections explicitly includes a `userId` field, denormalizing the authorization context. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, making rules simpler (e.g., `allow read: if request.auth.uid == userId && request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId;`). This also enables atomic operations like creating a user and their initial settings or risk limits in a single batch, without complex rule dependencies. For example, a new `Trade` document will be created under `/users/{userId}/trades/{tradeId}` and will contain `trade.userId`, allowing rules to verify ownership directly. Public or platform-wide data, such as AI-generated `Signals`, `FiiDiiData`, and `SignalsPerformance`, resides in top-level collections. This structural segregation ensures that `list` operations on these collections (which are not owned by a specific user) do not inadvertently expose private user data and allows for efficient, public-facing queries. For instance, a query for open positions on the dashboard would simply be `firestore.collection('users').doc(request.auth.uid).collection('trades').where('status', '==', 'OPEN')`, directly leveraging the `userId` path parameter for security. Similarly, active algorithms are found by querying `firestore.collection('users').doc(request.auth.uid).collection('algos').where('status', '==', 'Deployed')` and available funds from the primary `BrokerConnection` for the authenticated user. This design inherently supports Querying All Possibilities (QAPs) by ensuring that security rules are not filters; instead, the data structure itself enforces the security posture, allowing the platform to fetch exactly what the user is authorized to see with a single, permissioned query.
